purpose: Resolve an AC1021 HATCH failure cluster found during the local large-file screen, then determine whether the source still qualifies as an organic partial-read witness.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.interpretation: The pattern-line count is a bit short, followed by the declared number of line records.

source.provenance: Local corpus sample; producer and source history are unauthenticated. Read in place. No DWG or DXF fixture or derivative was copied into the repository.

initial_screen.failure_profile: All 28 failures are AC1021 HATCH (DWG type 78), phase 3, owner block 0x1f. The debug trace reaches style/pattern and fails before the first pattern-line record. Each peer-decoded HATCH has 405 definition lines.
initial_screen.peer_observation: The minJSON decode contains all 108878 source objects, including the selected HATCH records and their 405 definition lines. This peer result is diagnostic only and does not authenticate the source.

implementation.change: Factor the existing bounded, transactional table-body count check so it can decode either BL or BS; use the BS form for HATCH and MPOLYGON pattern definition-line counts. Other count fields retain BL decoding.
implementation.reason: The writer already emits these counts with putBitShort. The former parser used getBitLong, which diverges once the BS value uses its 16-bit payload form, such as 405.

checks: all pattern-line fields and nested dash values round-trip
truncated input fails and resets parsed pattern lines
the same parser object succeeds on retry with the complete frame

candidate_recheck.export: refused during strict output preparation; no DXF was created
candidate_recheck.refusal_context: The read still reports three integrity observations and one skipped custom class plus one skipped unsupported object. The strict-complete output gate refuses this source; the remaining diagnostics are outside the repaired HATCH count.

disposition: This source is no longer an entity-parse-failure candidate after the BS fix, so it cannot qualify P6-F's independently valid organic partial-read gate. Keep P6-F open for a different eligible source and separately prove guarded partial ASCII/Binary output, independent readback, atomic refusal and retry. The unauthenticated sample and peer agreement do not promote a support claim.
